facts.text: Under the St. Thomas Promise program, first-year Texas students with a family income of $50,000 or less receive full tuition and regular fees, renewable for up to four years.

sources.title: St. Thomas Promise - University of St.Thomas
sources.quote: First year Texas students with a core high school GPA of 3.4 or higher who have family income of $50,000 or less are eligible for our St. Thomas Promise program.

sources.title: St. Thomas Promise - University of St.Thomas
sources.quote: The St. Thomas Promise is renewable for up to four years, provided family income remains in the same qualifying range. St. Thomas Promise awards will cover full tuition (12-18 credit hours per semester) and regular fees.

facts.text: UST is Houston's only Catholic university, rooted in the Basilian tradition.

sources.title: Admissions - University of St.Thomas
sources.quote: UST is Houston's only Catholic university. Rooted in the Basilian tradition of goodness, discipline, and knowledge, we bring faith and learning together
